contract.title: R03 final exact-commit cold-start completeness review
contract.goal: Act as a fresh reviewer with no reliance on earlier conclusions. Determine whether a new operator can mechanically apply the five-way R03 decision using only the declared persisted artifacts. Check exact artifact completeness; that required control and candidate counters fail loud when missing; that the canonical classifier CLI verifies persisted V2 analysis identity and integrity instead of accepting an unverified in-memory dictionary; that the matrix request binds the decision contract hash and the generated RUNBOOK contains the same canonical command; that a changed decision contract invalidates old compiled analysis; that decision thresholds have one synchronized source; and that code readiness, authorization readiness, experimental result and permissible research claim are kept separate. Pay special attention to ordered overflow handling: an already localized 5 MHz control-pressure stop precedes candidate-arm unlocalized overflow, while otherwise unlocalized ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW must block classification rather than become pressure or no-pressure. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES. Do not edit files. Never emit example or placeholder evidence: every evidence item must use the exact github://fuguther/leo-direct-sim/blob/307c796c3ad5d0e8fb2528e933019fba7cecc43f/<allowed-path>#Lx-Ly form; omit a finding if you cannot supply that form.
acceptance: Verify the exact commit and declared artifact set.
Verify a new operator can mechanically distinguish all five classification branches from persisted verified artifacts.
Verify missing required counters and unlocalized ISL overflow fail loud.
Verify the canonical CLI performs persisted analysis verification before classification.
Verify the decision contract hash and canonical command are bound across request, compiled analysis, verifier and RUNBOOK.
Verify thresholds and branch order are synchronized across contract, implementation, tests and operator instructions.
Verify code readiness, authorization readiness, observed result and research claim are stated separately.
requiredEvidence: Line-grounded exact-commit evidence with no placeholders
At least one mechanism counterexample or covered regression
Explicit open_items and PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES
